documents.title: Executive Director Monthly Report — August 2026
documents.author: Jeffery Howard, Executive Director
documents.summary: Operational highlights: 48 successful adoptions, 12 lost pet reunions, and 32 spay/neuter surgeries subsidized through community voucher funds. Shelter occupancy remained steady at 88%. Reconciled QBO general ledger to August 31 bank statements with $0.00 credit card register variance. Architectural drawings finalized for the 800 sq ft Cat Room expansion.
highlights: 100% compliance rating on MDARD annual state shelter inspection
Reconciled QBO register to August 31 bank statement ($24,526.34 statement cash)
3 new staff members certified in Fear-Free Shelter Animal Handling

documents.title: FASB ASC 250 Accounting Memorandum: Elan Credit Card True-Up
documents.author: Finance & Audit Committee
documents.summary: Technical accounting memorandum detailing the elimination of arbitrary plug JE 7877 ($10,790.33), the posting of $645.32 in 2026 source-level rebate credits (Txns 7916, 7917, 7918), and the recording of a $10,145.01 prior-period adjustment (Txn 7919) against Net Assets to correct historical opening balance and 2025 statement credits.
highlights: Live QBO register matches Elan bank feed to the penny ($7,129.84 = $7,129.84)
Aug 31 Balance Sheet credit card liability certified at $6,912.09
Fully compliant with GAAP and FASB ASC 250 reporting standards

documents.title: 2026 Board Governance Manual, Conflict of Interest & Fiduciary Controls
documents.author: HSMC Governance Committee
documents.summary: Official governance manual defining board trustee duties, Form 990 Schedule L conflict-of-interest guidelines, related-party transaction disclosure rules, dual-signature payment authorization thresholds, and investment policy criteria for the Fidelity reserve.
highlights: Form 990 Schedule L annual conflict-of-interest disclosure standards
Dual-authorization required for operational disbursements exceeding $2,500
Board designated reserve withdrawal policy (supermajority vote required)
Whistleblower protection and document retention policies

documents.title: MDARD Annual Animal Shelter Inspection — Certificate of Compliance
documents.author: Michigan Dept of Agriculture & Rural Development (MDARD)
documents.summary: Official State of Michigan shelter inspection certification verifying 100% compliance across canine housing, feline isolation, medical room sterilization, intake documentation, rabies vaccine tracking, and veterinary emergency protocols.
highlights: Commendation for new climate control and upgraded commercial sterilization equipment
Medical isolation room verified in full compliance with state rules
